finding.title: Package lifecycle script entry changed
finding.observation: Manifest key scripts.postinstall is reported as removed from the artifact.
finding.whyItMatters: Lifecycle entries can affect package-manager installation behavior; inspect the exact command and its source before deciding what it does. This observation does not establish malicious intent.
limitations: The producer-retained manifest delta supplies the old/new value direction; this M1 rule does not analyze referenced file behavior or establish intent.
nextActions: Review the retained old and new script values and their referenced files; do not execute them on the host.
